text:
The Hurricanes spent June lifting the Stanley Cup, with Jordan Staal taking the Conn Smythe, and they have spent November playing like a team that intends to do it again. At 16-3-3 they have 35 points, and our playoff odds round to 100%, with an 83% chance at the Metropolitan title.

This is not a team riding luck. Carolina gets 60% of the expected goals, our measure of the quality of chances, and 58% at 5-on-5. The line of Nikolaj Ehlers, Logan Stankoven and Jackson Blake has outscored teams 13-1 at even strength on a 71% share of the chances, which is about as dominant as a trio gets. Sebastian Aho's line with Andrei Svechnikov also wins its minutes comfortably, and Aho got to score at home in Finland at the Global Series in Helsinki.

If there's a bonus, it's in net: the Canes have allowed about 8.5 fewer goals than their chances against suggest, and Pyotr Kochetkov has saved 4.5 goals above expected over his last five starts. Our numbers say they have about three more points than their play earned, a small cushion for a team this good.

Staal is back from injured reserve and near a milestone, while rumor sites keep linking Alexander Nikishin to Toronto. Thursday's 2-1 loss to Montreal, with Lane Hutson scoring both goals, was a reminder that even this group can go passive for a stretch.
headline: The champions look like champions again
